title: Hazel and the Wolf
author: W. M. Hartwell
blurb: Marguerite Thornbury, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
